research_points.description: Research Points (RP) measure applied scientific work. Operational Research Labs generate RP and assigned labs apply that RP directly to active directed projects.
research_points.reason: Scientific effort is generated continuously; civilizations should not bank centuries of generic points and instantly complete a newly discovered field.
research_points.unassigned_lab_behavior: Unassigned lab capacity contributes to basic science, field competence, hypothesis generation, evidence processing, and low-rate exploratory research rather than being completely wasted.

research_labs.description: Research Labs are effective research-capacity units. Early facilities can contribute one unit each; later institutes, orbital laboratories, specialized complexes, machine research systems, biological equivalents, or alien equivalents may contribute multiple effective units without requiring thousands of individually simulated buildings.
research_labs.parallel_research_policy: Early civilizations can formally direct one major strategic research program. Research-infrastructure discoveries unlock multiple directed programs. At the mature stage there is no arbitrary project-slot ceiling; enough unreserved effective lab capacity must exist to satisfy every active project's minimum lab requirement.
research_labs.reason: Early simplicity is preserved without claiming all scientists research one subject. Later concurrency emerges from institutional coordination plus physical scientific capacity rather than a permanent arbitrary research-slot cap.

research_pressure.description: Research Pressure is contextual need/evidence, separate from RP. Only explicitly pressure-gated technologies require one or more pressure values to reach a threshold before becoming Investigable.
research_pressure.decay_rule: Pressure decays gradually when the underlying condition disappears unless persistent evidence/history keeps it relevant.
research_pressure.sources: Actual conditions such as shortages, losses, health burdens, strategic performance gaps, hazards, observed foreign capabilities, and scientific evidence.
research_pressure.rubber_band_rule: No artificial catch-up bonus. A weaker civilization can naturally acquire higher pressure from real problems while a dominant civilization can become less urgent or more complacent if it sees no credible need.

foundation.description: Well-understood extensions of established science; often visible through ordinary scientific development without a crisis.

developing.description: Substantial programs requiring multiple research teams. Pressure is a hard gate only where a node explicitly declares a pressure requirement.

advanced.description: Large coordinated scientific/engineering efforts. Advanced basic-science paths can still appear without pressure when knowledge/evidence supports them.

frontier.description: Civilization-scale frontier research. Frontier status never creates a pressure gate by itself; pressure applies only when explicitly configured.

base_work_formula.description: Seed inherent project workload before civilization-specific readiness. Context changes progress efficiency rather than multiplying total project cost through stacks of independent bonuses/penalties.

lab_scaling.description: More laboratories can accelerate a project, but coordination and duplicated work create realistic diminishing returns. There is no arbitrary hard cap; very large programs simply become increasingly inefficient.

contextual_progress.description: After lab allocation/diminishing returns, project RP progress is multiplied by one bounded readiness efficiency derived from field competence, facility readiness, relevant evidence, and tacit expertise. Non-applicable components are omitted and remaining weights renormalized.
contextual_progress.hard_missing_requirement_policy: Block/pause the relevant stage and explain the missing facility/evidence/material/capability instead of converting impossibility into an extreme RP penalty.

availability_rules.pressure_gated: Only a node listed with required_pressure or required_pressure_any is hard-gated by Research Pressure. Complexity alone never creates a pressure gate.
availability_rules.basic_science: Nodes exposed through basic science may become Hypothesized/Investigable without a practical pressure threshold when prerequisite knowledge, evidence, applicability, and laboratory requirements are satisfied.
availability_rules.evidence_gated: Foreign/anomaly nodes can require evidence tokens regardless of pressure.
availability_rules.lab_gated: A technology may be known/hypothesized but cannot enter active research until the civilization can assign at least the minimum labs required by its complexity/default or node override.
availability_rules.concurrency_gated: Starting another directed project also requires institutional capacity for another simultaneous major program, until the mature autonomous-portfolio stage removes the slot ceiling.
availability_rules.prerequisite_gated: All prerequisite knowledge/capability requirements must still be satisfied.

pressure_threshold_guidance.0: No contextual need required; ordinary basic science can expose the project.
pressure_threshold_guidance.40: Serious strategic, environmental, medical, industrial, or scientific need.
pressure_threshold_guidance.60: Major or sustained civilization-level pressure or compelling evidence.
pressure_threshold_guidance.80: Extreme/existential pressure; reserved for special public technologies or crisis-driven programs, not a generic late-game tax.

early_game_ui.pressure_display_policy: Show the relevant pressure only once the civilization has enough knowledge to recognize the problem/field. Do not expose hidden future branches through UI meters.
early_game_ui.readiness_display_policy: Keep early UI simple. Show a short readiness label and clear missing requirements; expose detailed theory/experiment/engineering and facility/tacit breakdowns in advanced research details.
early_game_ui.auto_allocation: Starting a project can auto-assign the recommended number of currently available eligible labs, falling back to the minimum if capacity is limited. The player can reallocate manually.
